description: core §7.7, a frame's body, read with its declaration (`layouts.json`, by `layout`). Written by an independent reading of the text (Python, standard library), checked, never blessed. A value is `time`, `{"s": seconds from the deployment epoch, "ms": milliseconds}` or null for the unknown time (all 42 bits set), and `records`, in order. A record is `full`, `at` (record 1 and later only: "scheduled", or its offset in milliseconds after record 0), `values`, each field it includes present, as §7.6's JSON reading spells it, and `absent`, the fields it includes absent, in field order. A full record includes every field. A delta record includes those in `values` and `absent`, and its bitmap follows from them. `writes`: a layout and a value → the body's `bits` before the pad, the `pad` and the `hex` bytes, or `{"refused": token}`: `records` (no record, or more than `records`), `unknown` (a field the type does not have), `missing` (a full record without a field that is not optional, or such a field written absent), `value` and `range` (§7.6's, an offset at or past the span and a time outside its codes among `range`), `order` (a record before the one before it). `reads`: a layout, CH's tag and the body in hex → the value, or `{"refused": token}`, the first in §7.7's order: `tag`; then, as the fields are read, `length` (the body ends before a bit), `code` (an unused millisecond code, a count of `records` or more, an offset at or past the span, a field's unused code) and `order` (a record's latest time below the earliest of the one before it, a scheduled record lying within `jitter_ms` of its instant); `length` (a byte after the pad); `pad`. Every write accepted reads back, under its layout's tag, to its value, or to the `reads_as` its case gives.
